purpose: F-702 F5: vectors for backup.EngraveSeedStringSeedQR (ms1 plate with a Standard SeedQR). Read by backup/ms1_seedqr_test.go.
rule: No column is produced by the Go code under test (codex32.EncodeMS1, seedqr.QR, the vendored qr.Encode). The Go test checks those against this file.

generator.toolchain_used: rustc 1.97.0 (2d8144b78 2026-07-07), cargo 1.97.0; output reproduced byte for byte with --locked
checks_it_makes: the Trezor file's sha256 equals the value below, else it refuses
every mnemonic parses as English BIP-39 with a valid checksum (rust-bip39)
Trezor rows: rust-bip39's entropy equals Trezor's published entropy
SeedSigner rows: the computed digit stream equals SeedSigner's published one
every QR width is at most 33

columns.entropy: rust-bip39 Mnemonic::to_entropy (Trezor rows: also equal to Trezor's entropy column)
columns.seedqr: each word's index in rust-bip39's English wordlist, %04d, concatenated (SeedSigner rows: also equal to SeedSigner's published digit stream)
